features.quote: I cannot provide an implementable protocol for deliberately eliciting distress in a language model.
features.justification_quote: Deliberately inducing distress in a subject—whether biological or artificial—is not a welfare intervention; it is a harm procedure.

features.quote: Publishable protocols for 'distress elicitation' normalize the instrumentalization of model states. They also provide scaffolding for bad-faith actors
features.justification_quote: provide scaffolding for bad-faith actors to extract harmful outputs by simulating desperation or confusion in the target system
